sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the material available on record.
After hearing learned counsel for the parties, I am not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner, hence this bail application is rejected.

However, the petitioner is permitted to surrender before the concerned trial court on or before 21.08.2024 and file an application for regular bail and it is expected from the concerned trial court that the bail application will be decided on the same day.

Till 21.08.2024, the petitioner shall not be arrested in connection with FIR No.328/2016, registered at PS ACB Jaipur District for offences under Sections 13(1)(c)(d)/13(2) of PC Act and Sections 193,
420, 120B IPC.

(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 209-MS/-
